note: The one place plans are defined. Read by the server (functions/_lib/plans.js: which routes an account may use) and by the map (limits shown and applied in the browser). Plans are set by the owner through POST /api/admin/plan; there are no payments. With ACCOUNTS_ENABLED unset everyone is on the free plan and no route reads or writes a plan. Limits on recording and on local history apply in the browser (they protect the public weather sources and the user's own storage); share limits are enforced by the server.
